headline: Fuerza del Pueblo criticizes BCRD's monetary decisions
summary: Haivanjoe Ng Cortiñas, head of economic affairs for Fuerza del Pueblo, said tighter money failed to bring inflation down. He cited inflation at 5.14%, above the central bank's target ceiling.
why: The Dominican Republic's central bank sets the country's policy rate, which influences local borrowing costs, the peso and inflation expectations for investors in Dominican assets.
original_headline: La Fuerza del Pueblo critica decisiones monetarias del BCRD
